title: TEMPERATE TREE FRUIT, BERRIES, GRAPES, AND NUTS
description: Covers fruit and nut crops for temperate zones. Emphasis placed on scientific and common names, plant adaptation, basic morphology, major cultivars, and markets. Offered alternate years.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
